text:
maria-support: FYI customer ACME reported a spike of 504 / gateway timeouts on hosted inference for tenant acme-prod. They saw ~30% error rate for ~12 minutes starting ~11:02 UTC. Ticket: https://zendesk.company/12345 

jon-eng: ack. Any sample request IDs and the gateway logs? Need to confirm if it's upstream 5xx or scale-up related.

maria-support: sample request id: req_20260317_11_05_21. Gateway log snippet: 
```
gateway: proxy -> upstream timeout (upstream: inference-svc acme-prod) status=504 latency=12000ms
upstream: no healthy upstream, scaleup in progress
```
Also attached customer's trace showing requests queuing then 504s.

ravi-sre: sounds like scale-up lag. Can you paste the KEDA ScaledObject / HPA for that namespace and k8s events for pods? Common suspects: minReplicaCount=0 + long model init time, or external metric not being emitted so scaler doesn't trigger.

maria-support: ScaledObject snippet: 
```
apiVersion: keda.sh/v1alpha1
kind: ScaledObject
metadata:
  name: acme-inference-scaledobject
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    deploymentName: acme-inference-deployment
  minReplicaCount: 0
  maxReplicaCount: 20
  cooldownPeriod: 300
  pollingInterval: 30
  triggers:
  - type: prometheus
    metadata:
      serverAddress: http://prometheus.monitoring.svc
      metricName: inference_queue_length
      threshold: '50'
```
k8s events: no HPA activity during the spike; pods remained at 0 -> started scaling after ~45s, but model init took ~20s/pod.

jon-eng: two immediate issues: minReplicaCount=0 and pollingInterval 30s + cooldown 300s is too conservative for sudden tenant bursts. Also threshold=50 might be too high if requests are short but bursty. If external metric isn't scraped quickly, scaler misses the activation window.

lena-product: note we just rolled a model image with larger initialization (cold start ~20s). That increases the effective scale-up time. For critical tenants we should avoid min=0.

ravi-sre: agree. From prometheus graphs I see a ~60s gap where the metric peaked but scaler didn't act because scrape/polling missed it. HPA wasn't present because we rely on KEDA external metrics. Quick mitigation: bump minReplicaCount to 1 for acme-prod and reduce pollingInterval to 5s for the ScaledObject, set cooldownPeriod to 60. Proposal commands: 
```
kubectl patch scaledobject acme-inference-scaledobject -n acme --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/minReplicaCount","value":1}]'
kubectl patch scaledobject acme-inference-scaledobject -n acme --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/pollingInterval","value":5},{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/cooldownPeriod","value":60}]'
```

maria-support: can we apply that now? Customer is blocking.

ravi-sre: applying patch now. Will monitor.

deploy-bot: autoscaler patch applied by ravi-sre at 2026-03-17T11:15:07Z (change: minReplicaCount 0 -> 1, pollingInterval 30 -> 5, cooldownPeriod 300 -> 60).

ravi-sre: patched and forcing 1 replica provision: 
```
kubectl scale deployment acme-inference-deployment --replicas=1 -n acme
```

customer-bot: customer ACME confirms error rate dropped to <1% within 90s after the change. "Thanks for the fast response". :thumbsup: 

jon-eng: follow-ups: 1) Add a prewarm policy for tenants with known burst patterns (minReplicaCount>=1 or scheduled prewarm). 2) Add alert rule when model init time > 10s or when scaledobject polling misses multiple peaks. 3) Re-evaluate threshold/metric cardinality (use per-tenant activation metric instead of global queueLength).

lena-product: we'll coordinate a config change for customer tiers and add to runbook. Also consider shipping a lightweight warm container to speed init.

maria-support: Logging this as a customer escalation resolved. We'll open a post-incident action (PIA) with owners: eng-runtime (jon-eng), eng-sre (ravi-sre), product (lena-product). Proposed remediation: set sensible minReplicaCount for high-SLA tenants, reduce pollingInterval for sensitive scaledobjects, and instrument activation metric.

ravi-sre: adding repro steps for the postmortem: 1) simulate burst on a tenant with minReplicaCount=0 and model-init=20s, 2) observe ScaledObject polling misses at 30s interval, 3) measure end-to-end request latency and 504 rate. I'll attach scripts in the PIA.

maria-support: closing thread; please comment in PIA with any further notes.
